title: Shared-environment operational certification (Internal Pilot)
authority_note: Non-destructive certification of engineered correctness in the shared environment. Does NOT authorise Trusted Beta, production arming, or customer invitations. verdict_scope_note: Each area `verdict` is scoped to ENGINEERED correctness proven by the executed repo tests (cited counts). It is NOT a statement of live shared-environment readiness: that is additionally gated by each area's `host_verified_items` and by `pilot_recommendation.conditions`. Most important: area B lists 'live demo VALIDATE_LOGIN on host (not yet succeeded)' as a host_verified item and pilot condition 1 — the engineered lifecycle is PASS, but a live broker login has NOT been proven on the host. Read verdict + host_verified_items + conditions together; a bare PASS is never a readiness claim.
